profile.headline: Founder & CEO, Def0x | Startup Engineer & Product Strategist | Shipping AI‑Driven MVPs & Platforms from Zero to Launch
profile.summary:
👋 I'm Robinson Cook, Founder of Def0x — a fractional CTO and startup development agency that partners with non-technical founders from zero to market to scale.
I don't build apps on spec. I work alongside founders to figure out what to build, validate whether it matters, and ship production-ready products using lean startup methodology. System audits, MVP development, ongoing technical leadership — whatever the problem calls for. No waterfall, no bloat, no six-month builds that miss the mark.
I'm also building Pawprint, a dog health platform that tracks walks, logs vet visits and health events, and generates AI-powered vet summaries — so dog owners actually have a complete picture of their dog's health between appointments. No hardware, no collar. Just a living health record built from the walks you're already taking.
If you're a founder who needs a technical partner — not a vendor — let's talk.
